name: Undead Vendetta
source:
Step into the shadowy world of Rosewood City, where your ordinary life as a waitress is about to morph into a tantalizing quest to break an ancient curse. Immerse yourself in a sultry romance with three enigmatic vampire brothers—Niall, the irresistible philanthropist; Vane, the mysterious antique appraiser; and D’Arcy, the seductive club owner—in a spellbinding tale of forbidden desires and dark secrets. Will you unravel their hidden truths and reignite their eternal longing, Mistress?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.moonlightblood]Google Play[/url]]
